description: ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: irrigation datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by ogc.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 17 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about irrigation; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Zones de passage liées aux canalisations souterraines d'irrigation dan; Canaux et autres ouvrages de transport pour l'irrigation dans le Haut-; Canalisations souterraines d'irrigation génératrices de servitudes A2 ; Table contenant les assiettes linéaires liées aux servitudes de la cat. Formats seen: WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
